'''Mike Smith Jedi training - Hoth''' is a [[Light]] Jedi Test list Mike Smith posted for review.<ref name="list-58703">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/58703.html? swccg-discussion message #58703], Mike Smith (1 October 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110090540/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/58703.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Mike Smith
* '''Published:''' 1 October 1998 (swccg-discussion)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah|Dagobah-L-dagobah.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jedi training - Hoth
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE JediHoth Smith LS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Smith wrote that the aim was to have fun and a feel of the Rebellion's struggle.
